pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:100 the heal cap is looked up by row id in session memory while every retry mints a new row (src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:944) whose persisted attempt is never checked, so auto-heal retries each child failure afresh and the lineage has no bound

techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/SelfHealingPanel.tsx:78 maxRetries lives in a useState counter keyed by the per-attempt row id (rules 3+4: attempt count in the row, identity minted once); src-tauri/db/src/repos/dev/tasks.rs:944 persists parent_task_id/attempt but no heal path reads them, so a reload or each new child row resets the ladder
